feeds.title: A Journal of Musical Things » Ottawa
feeds.description: A Journal of Musical Things gives you the latest on what is happening in music in Ottawa to save you time and effort. Alan Cross is a professional music geek, a TV & radio broadcaster, writer, speaker and consultant.

feeds.title: Also Cool » Music
feeds.description: Also Cool covers everything from indie rock to after-hours DJs. Keep up to date with the latest Canadian & international underground music. Also Cool was founded by artists, for artists, and created their platform as an accessible space for creatives at all levels of their careers to showcase their talent, and to get published!

feeds.title: Wyntr Band Blog
feeds.description: Find out about the latest performances, releases, reviews, mp3s and more on the blog. Get all your news, show announcements, music, videos and more right here on the official website of the Hard Rock power trio - Wyntr.

feeds.title: Apartment613 » Music
feeds.description: Read what's going on in Music with Apartment613's blog. They are a volunteer-run not-for-profit organization. Their award winning blog is dedicated to uncovering the best of Ottawa's arts and culture with the help of their dedicated team.

feeds.title: PhotogMusic » Music
feeds.description: I'm Ming Wu of PhotogMusic bringing you the latest in Indie music with photos, music videos and reviews. I'm a photographer and I have a big passion for music and the arts/culture happening in and around the city. I also host a radio show and play indie, pop, rock, dance, folk, punk and more!

feeds.title: Allegro Music School Blog
feeds.description: Discover what's new in Music & Music Education! For 35 years Allegro has encouraged students to study and explore music in a dynamic learning environment. Our amazing, experienced team of teachers teach lessons across all instruments, styles, and for all ages.

feeds.title: TD Ottawa Jazz Festival
feeds.description: For ten days in the summer, the transformative, vibrant energy of jazz is masterfully played by musicians from Canada and around the world. Find out about the TD Ottawa Jazz Festival, lineup, tickets and more. The festival programming has been a trailblazer in the complexities and explorations of jazz for over 40 years.

feeds.title: The Revue
feeds.description: The Revue regularly publishes their article named 'The Matinee', where they curate and review a list of indie songs, all sporting a different theme each time. They are Indie Music Connoisseurs that developed a reputation over time for discovering music's hidden gems and for writing reviews that are thoughtful and considerate. They also write about music festivals and concerts.

feeds.title: Paragon Cause
feeds.description: News, reviews and blogs by Ottawa Band Paragon Cause. Includes information on new albums, gear reviews, music reviews and anything else the we find interesting. We post news articles and stories about all things music and musical gear and instrument related, as well as how we do things and advice on recording and playing with synthesizers, guitar pedals and microphones.

feeds.title: My Life in Music Lists » Ottawa
feeds.description: The live music gallery features digital photographs taken at various concerts, of some of my favorite sets. Take a look at my ever-growing list of concerts. These are the songs that have and will continue to soundtrack my life. I'm JP Robichaud, a writer, blogger, beer connoisseur, and vinyl snob in training and this is my life in music lists.
